name: Big River Regional Park, Cowan Lake Campground
note: Big River Regional Park's lakeside campground on Cowan Lake at the end of Main Street, with a fish-filleting shack, a camp kitchen and gazebo, and the town dock and free boat launch beside it. The park's dump station and coin showers are at its Community Centre Campground on the north side of town, about 1.2 km away. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: saskregionalparks.ca/park/big-river/ (Big River Regional Park Authority, regional park opened 1978 on town/RM land; 'Big River Regional Park is composed of two campgrounds. Cowan Lake Campground, located at the end of Main Street ... wide-open spaces to accommodate any size of camper. This campground has modern full services'; 'Cowan Lake Campground has (14) 30 amp sites and (2) 50 amp electrical sites as well as non-serviced sites'; nightly 30 A full service C$35, 50 A C$40, non-serviced 'Cowan Lake and Community Centre Campgrounds' C$22, taxes in; the 12 seasonal sites are at the Community Centre Campground only) + the operator's Cowan Lake map (Big-River-Cowan-Lake.jpg: 16 drive-in pads A-P on a loop road) + Tourism Saskatchewan listing 1663 + SRPA 2026 guide (accredited, 'Reservations: By phone or email') + Google 'Big River Regional Park' 4.3 (46), 306-469-2232 (one listing for the whole park, pinned at the Community Centre), read 2026-11-19 -> real public RV campground, all sites sold by the night/week/month, no seasonal leases, no lots. Local: no price gate. Esri imagery: two rows of ~8 open grass pads ~15 m long, no fit limit posted. Not a duplicate: 9210 (the park's Community Centre Campground, 800 1st St N) is 1.18 km NE with its own entrance; nothing else in the DB within 15 km. (phase-7 SK lead 6, found p3-527) --Claude
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery z17 tiles (satz.py, ~0.7 m/px, rendered; z18 'Map data not yet available', export endpoint 500s under ~350 m half-width; the Wayback scan listed no captures) viewed 2026-11-19 at 53.8303,-107.0375, matched to the operator's Cowan Lake map (16 pads A-P in two rows inside a loop road, office and dock on the lake side, volleyball court opposite): the pads sit on open, treeless lawn above the SW shore of Cowan Lake. The row nearest the water (C/D end of the C-D-G-H-K-L-O-P column, per the map's orientation against the dock, buildings and volleyball court) is ~20-25 m from the water's edge at its west end and ~45-50 m at its east end, with grass, the loop road (drawn on the map, not resolvable on imagery) and a ~6-8 m tan bank strip between; the dock photo on the SRP page shows reeds and shrubs along this shore. No trees between pads and lake, so the sightline is open -> lakeview. Lakefront not earned: the map puts the loop road between the pads and the shore, and at 0.7 m/px the bank strip can't be told apart from a reed fringe; no site photo exists. Default down. --Claude

fees.note: 30-amp full service C$35 a night (C$240 a week, C$770 a month), 50-amp C$40 (C$245 / C$840), non-serviced C$22; park entry C$10 a day or a seasonal park pass. Taxes included.

booking.note: Off season (mid September to May 15) by e-mail or message and the park calls back; from May 15 by the office phone. Cancellations 14+ days out are refunded in full, under 14 days 50%, under 7 days nothing; date changes C$20; no refunds on long-weekend bookings.
